buyer_added_terms.text: OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Provisions for workmen compensation, insurance, public liability, property damage, insurance etc. to be ensured by the contractor. Also, safety measures prescribed for working in Extra High Voltage & use of personnel protective equipment must be adhered to. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA / TERMS & CONDITIONS- On behalf of DJB, EE(E&M)M-17 invite Gem Bid on item rate basis from the contractors of DJB/ MES/ CPWD/ PWD/ Railway /any Delhi Govt. departments registered in appropriate category, class & tendering limit who have executed simila r nature of works & from manufacturers /authorized service centres /authorized distributors /auth orized dealers for their specific works and will be received electronically and opened as per sched ule mentioned below. Bidders shall have to comply with all the terms and conditions, circulars, con tract conditions etc., issued by DJB time to time. 1. Affidavit / Undertaking: The bidder shall submit a scanned copy of an undertaking on e-Non-Judicial Stamp Paper, duly notar ized in the prescribed format, declaring that the firm has not been debarred/blacklisted by any Government Department/PSU/Autonomous Body as on the date of submission of Bid. The affidavit s hall be valid for at least one month from the date of opening of the Bid. The firm shall also give an u ndertaking that no relative by blood relation of the bidder/proprietor/partners/directors is working in Delhi Jal Board. 2. Statutory Documents: The bidder shall submit copies of the latest ITR, GST Registration, PAN and other applicable statutor y registrations/documents and shall comply with all prevailing statutory requirements. 3. Pending Works / Performance: The bid shall not be considered in case the bidder has failed to complete any already awarded work/ supply order within the stipulated completion period or has failed to respond to departmental requir ements during the applicable Defect Liability/Guarantee Period. The bidder shall submit a certificate that no work is pending beyond the stipulated completion period in the Division of EE(E&M) M-17. 4. Electrical Licence: For E&M works requiring an electrical licence, the firm shall possess a valid Electrical Contractor Lic ence issued by the competent authority and shall submit a copy thereof with the Technical Bid. 5. Conditional / Ambiguous Bids: Conditional Bids shall be rejected outright. Bids containing material ambiguity or deviation from the NIT conditions shall also be liable to rejection. 6. Verification of Documents: Delhi Jal Board reserves the right to examine and verify the authenticity of any document/informatio n submitted by the bidder at any stage of the Bid/contract. 7. Submission of Documents: All documents submitted with the Technical Bid shall be clear, legible, readable and complete. Non- submission of mandatory documents or submission of illegible documents may render the bid liable to rejection. 8. Compliance with DJB Conditions: The bidder shall comply with the General Conditions of Contract, NIT conditions and applicable circul ars/orders/instructions issued by Delhi Jal Board from time to time. 9. Labour Laws: Wherever manpower/labour is engaged for execution of the work, the contracting agency shall be s olely responsible for compliance with applicable Labour Laws, Minimum Wages Act, EPF, ESI and oth er statutory provisions. Any penalty/liability arising due to non-compliance shall be borne by the con tracting agency. 10. Site Inspection: Bidders are advised to inspect the site and acquaint themselves with the site conditions, scope of w ork and other relevant requirements before quoting their rates. Submission of the bid shall be deem ed to imply that the bidder has understood the site conditions and scope of work. 11. Responsibility for Staff / Machinery: The firm shall be fully responsible for the staff/labour deployed by it, maintenance of statutory recor

ds, safety of personnel, tools, plants and machinery and for any accident/mishap arising during exe cution of the work. DJB shall not be responsible for any loss, claim or liability attributable to the cont ractor's operations, subject to applicable law and contractual provisions. 12. Manufacturer / Authorized Dealer: The bidder shall be the Manufacturer or an Authorized Dealer of the Manufacturer for the material/e quipment offered and shall submit valid documentary proof wherever required. 13. Approved Make: Only makes approved/accepted by Delhi Jal Board and specified in the NIT/BOQ shall be acceptabl e. 14. False Information: If any information/document furnished by the bidder is found to be false, fabricated or misleading at any stage, appropriate action shall be taken against the firm as per applicable DJB rules/contract co nditions, including rejection/termination/debarment, as applicable. 15. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): The bidder shall deposit EMD amounting to Rs. 34000/- in favour of EE(E&M) M-17, Delhi Jal B oard, in the prescribed mode, and proof thereof shall be submitted with the Technical Bid. Non-sub mission of the prescribed EMD, unless exempted under applicable rules, shall render the bid liable t o rejection. 16. Additional Performance Guarantee: If the quoted amount/rates attract the requirement of Additional Performance Guarantee under the applicable DJB rules/NIT provisions, including where the quoted rates are more than 25% below the departmental justified rates, the successful bidder shall submit the prescribed Additional Performan ce Guarantee before execution of the contract. The PG shall be furnished in favour of EE(E&M) M- 17, Delhi Jal Board, as per applicable departmental provisions. 17. Completion Period: The supply/work covered under the Bid shall be completed within 180 days from the date stipulate d in the Work Order/Supply Order. 18. Guarantee Period: The material/equipment supplied shall carry a Guarantee Period of 12 months from the date of satisfactory completion/commissioning/acceptance, as applicable under the contract. 19. Procurement Documents: The firm shall submit duly signed and stamped copies of genuine procurement documents/purchase vouchers/invoices relating to the material supplied/procured under the contract, wherever required under DJB conditions. 20. Documents with Bill: At the time of submission of the bill, the firm shall submit the applicable supporting documents, incl uding defaced purchase vouchers/invoices, Test Certificates, Challans and E-Way Bills, wh erever applicable. The challan shall be duly acknowledged/signed by the Site In-charge in supply ca ses. The firm shall be solely responsible for the authenticity of all such documents submitted with t he running/final bill. 21. Payment: Payment shall be processed only after satisfactory completion and acceptance of the supply/work a nd submission of all requisite documents, subject to the terms and conditions of the contract and av ailability of applicable approvals/budget. 22. GST: Payment/reimbursement of GST shall be regulated as per applicable Government rules and Delhi Jal Board terms and conditions. 23. Intimation of Delivery: In supply cases, the firm shall intimate the delivery of material to the office of EE(E&M) M-17 throu gh e-mail at eeemm17.djb@gmail.com 24. immediately after delivery. 25. IP Address Condition: Bidders are advised not to submit bids for two or more different firms from the same IP address. If participation of two or more firms from the same IP address is detected, the bids shall be dealt wit h as per applicable e-procurement/DJB rules and may be liable to rejection. 26. Departmental Rights: Delhi Jal Board reserves the right to verify the credentials, statutory registrations, authorization certi ficates, procurement documents, invoices, test certificates and other documents submitted by the bidder at any stage and to take appropriate action in case of any discrepancy, misrepresentation or non-compliance. .
